Olga / team — heads up from ledger side after poking at the blocked invoice (PROC-8421):

- The invoice uses code SVC-CLOUD-001 which maps to an old product family that was deprecated last quarter. Our AR mapping expects SVC-INFRA-020. That discrepancy triggers the portal block.
- Line item 2 ("extra hours") was submitted as USD 7,200 but the ledger expects that to be split across two cost-centers (eng-services / infra-support). AP treats the single-line amount as unallocated.

Recommended path: reissue final PO with explicit line allocations and correct ledger code. Given the nature of the April deliverable, propose final PO-97531 (non-TEMP) with an adjusted spend cap of $45,000 and line breakdown:
  1) Core infra services — $30,000 — ledger SVC-INFRA-020
  2) Support/overflow hours — $10,000 — ledger ENG-SERV-110
  3) One-time onboarding credit (if applicable) — $5,000 — ledger MISC-300

Olga: can you reissue the final PO when vendor confirms the mapping? Karhith, can you pre-authorize the spend cap bump to $45k so we don't need an exec sign-off? (This is within established procurement thresholds for vendor type).

I'll also open a manual payment hold release request once we have the final PO number — that should clear the blocked invoice in AP. Adding the JIRA link for traceability: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-8421

- Marcus
